subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you use the documentation for help with using the project’s color palette to add highlights and shadows to each image asset?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What changes might be made to the Player sprite to create an Enemy “alter ego”?


Solution:

The playerForward image asset should be duplicated then modified with the paint tools and the project’s color palette to create an Enemy “alter ego” sprite.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ How can the Collectible sprite be edited so that it fits the color palette of the rest of the sprites?


Solution:

The ninja can either modify the existing asset or duplicate the Collectible sprite image. The chest should be replaced with colors from the project’s color palette.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where should the Enemy and Collectible sprite images be placed, so that they appear below the Player and Obstacle sprites?


Solution:

Enemy and Collectible sprites should be created, with their images set to their matching image assets. Both sprites should be placed on the same row, below the Player and Obstacle sprites.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to modify original pixel art images to use in the project!


The project already has a set color palette, a Player sprite facing 4 different directions, and Obstacle and Collectible sprites. 


Complete the sprite pack by creating an Enemy sprite, using the Player sprite image to create an “alter ego” Enemy. Update the asset’s name accordingly.


Each sprite image should only include colors from the project’s color palette. 


The Enemy and Collectible sprites should be placed on the screen, below the Player and Obstacle sprites.


Use the tools in the paint editor to build out the sprite pack!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating images that show multiple perspectives of the same sprite and themed sprite packs for projects. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Package Deal
badges.description: Create a sprite pack that includes different sprite kinds and different perspectives of those sprites, to be used in a project.

badges.title: Covering All My Bases
badges.description: Create pixel art images that show multiple points of view for a sprite: forward, backward, left, and right.

badges.title: Group by Theme
badges.description: Use a specific color palette and theme to create a sprite pack of different sprite kinds.

badges.title: The Gang’s All Here!
badges.description: Create a sprite pack of original pixel art images that includes Player, Collectible, Goal, Enemy, and Projectile sprites.
